oracle.ref: PR #1701 (fix); fix evidence: Stand 24/10/2026 develop 87a8969cb4: customer menu preview answered menu-photos not_configured (route runtime lacked keys.menuVision); Iron Fence stored 1.700/2.100 with scale 1000; demos fernhollow-al-barari-best-2 and iron-fence-saigon-2 (builds 1cbc7a5d, 71d041df) ended QA_NEEDS_REVIEW while showing disputed hours, no research logo, a header without brand, and template agency copy that QA counted as 0; the look got ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on <site>-web-1 because WordPress redirects to its site port.
oracle.invariant: S1: the customer preview plans menu-photos when a vision model is ready and keeps it when none is; the route refuses to boot without a runtime. S2: VND 1.700 with scale 1000 stores 1700; EUR 2,50 stores 2.50; USD 17.00 stays; ambiguous stays printed with scale null. S3: disputed hours on a page fail, event hours the brief holds pass; a header with no brand fails, a collected logo not imported or not in the header fails, the name passes when no logo was collected; a typeset quote with full credit passes and changed wording fails; every page of an unpublished demo is captured from the answering address. S4: the payload carries the withheld values, the brief without research, and the collected logo id.
